facts.text: The hotel is centrally located in Portland, Oregon, with views of the city skyline and the Cascade Range.
facts.excerpt: Centrally located, this luxury hotel in Portland, Oregon, boasts views of the city skyline and the Cascade Range.

facts.text: The Hidden Mountain Lake Infinity Pool is on the 19th floor, alongside the spa and fitness facility.
facts.excerpt: Step onto the 19th floor, home to Hidden Mountain Lake Infinity Pool, The Ritz-Carlton Spa, and a 4,000 square-foot ultra-modern fitness facility and movement studio.

facts.text: Bellpine, on the 20th floor, serves Mexican-inspired Pacific Northwest cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Set on the 20th floor and inspired by Oregon’s coastline, Bellpine presents Mexican-inspired Pacific Northwest cuisine.

facts.text: Meadowrue serves Japanese-inspired bites and a 12-course Omakase tasting menu.
facts.excerpt: Savor Japanese-inspired bites, an awe-inspiring mixology program, and a 12-course Omakase tasting menu.

facts.text: Meadowrue offers weekend live music and seasonal outdoor patio seating.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy weekend live music and seasonal outdoor patio seating for an al fresco experience

facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Suite is inspired by Multnomah Falls and sits 18 stories above downtown Portland.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by the frozen beauty of Multnomah Falls, this luxurious 2,700 sq. ft. sanctuary offers a serene escape where guests can host, play, and unwind at their leisure.

facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Suite has a hidden bar beside a billiards table.
facts.excerpt: a charming chest opens to unveil a hidden bar beside the billiards table

facts.text: The Flora & Fauna Suites are on the 18th floor, with views of either Mount Hood or Mount St. Helens.
facts.excerpt: Perched on the 18th floor, these two exceptional 1,460 sq. ft. suites offer sweeping views of either Mount Hood or Mount St. Helens.

facts.text: The spa has saunas, eucalyptus steam rooms, snow showers, a relaxation lounge, a nail salon and a retail boutique.
facts.excerpt: The Ritz-Carlton Spa, Portland features five treatment rooms, saunas and eucalyptus steam rooms, snow showers, a relaxation lounge, a nail salon, and a retail boutique.

facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Spa, Portland earned a 2026 Forbes Travel Guide 4-Star rating.
facts.excerpt: The Ritz-Carlton Spa, Portland has earned a 2026 Forbes Travel Guide 4-Star rating

facts.text: Club Lounge access requires a Club upgrade, and Bonvoy Elite Status does not include it.
facts.excerpt: Club upgrade required; Bonvoy Elite Status not included.

facts.text: Pool access is reserved exclusively for hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: Please note that pool access is reserved exclusively for hotel guests.

facts.text: An appointment is required at the spa.
facts.excerpt: An appointment is required at The Ritz-Carlton Spa, Portland.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler describes it as the first Ritz-Carlton in the Pacific Northwest.
facts.excerpt: The first Ritz-Carlton in the Pacific Northwest pays homage to the City of Roses.

facts.text: The blue-gray carpet throughout the hotel is an interpretation of the Willamette River.
facts.excerpt: blue-gray carpet throughout the hotel is an interpretation of the Willamette River

facts.text: Powell's bookstore is a four-minute walk from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Walk four minutes to Powell’s, the largest independent bookstore in the world

facts.text: Kids can sleep in an in-room sleeping tent with cozy bedding and a sweet treat delivery.
facts.excerpt: Treat your little ones to an in-room sleeping tent, complete with cozy bedding, thoughtful amenities, and a sweet treat delivery

facts.text: Meadowrue partnered with Coava Coffee on a house blend.
facts.excerpt: The bar has also partnered with Coava Coffee to create a unique blend for your morning cup of joe.
